auga_tip_mouse_sensitivity: Adjusts how fast the camera turns when you move the mouse. Higher values require less mouse movement to look around.
auga_tip_scroll_speed: Adjusts mouse-wheel scrolling in game and Auga lists. 100% is the mod's reference speed. The change takes effect when you select Apply.
auga_tip_invert_mouse: Reverses vertical mouse camera movement: moving the mouse up looks down, and vice versa.
auga_tip_reset_controls: Restores the default controls. Check the bindings before selecting Apply; Back restores the saved controls.
auga_tip_rebind: Click the displayed binding, then press the key or mouse button to assign to this action. Apply keeps the changes; Back restores the saved bindings.
auga_tip_gamepad_enabled: Enables gamepad input for controlling your character and navigating menus. Keyboard and mouse remain available.
auga_tip_swap_triggers: Swaps the assignments of the controller's trigger-related controls. Check the diagram below to see the updated layout.
auga_tip_invert_x: Reverses horizontal camera-stick movement: pushing right looks left, and vice versa.
auga_tip_invert_y: Reverses vertical camera-stick movement: pushing up looks down, and vice versa.
auga_tip_vibration: Adjusts vibration strength on supported controllers. A value of 0% disables vibration.
auga_tip_gamepad_sensitivity: Adjusts camera turning speed with the controller stick. Lower it for finer aiming or raise it to turn faster.
auga_tip_gamepad_type: Chooses the displayed button symbols, such as Xbox or PlayStation. Auto follows the detected controller. This does not change control assignments.
auga_tip_gamepad_layout: Chooses a preset controller layout. The diagram below shows the actions assigned to each button.
auga_tip_master_volume: Adjusts overall game volume, affecting both music and sound effects.
auga_tip_sfx_volume: Adjusts sound effects such as combat, movement and ambient sounds. Master volume also applies.
auga_tip_music_volume: Adjusts music volume without changing sound effects. Master volume also applies.
auga_tip_continuous_music: Allows music to continue without the usual pauses between tracks when music is available for the current situation.
auga_tip_auto_run: Lets you toggle running with a press instead of holding the run control. Applies to keyboard and controller.
auga_graphics_tip_resolution: Selects the window or screen resolution. Higher resolutions produce a sharper image but require more graphics performance.
auga_graphics_tip_test: Tries the selected resolution and display mode. Confirm to keep them; otherwise the game returns to the previous mode.
auga_graphics_tip_fullscreen: Displays the game full screen instead of in a window. Use Test to try the change.
auga_graphics_tip_renderresolution: Limits the resolution used to render the 3D world without lowering the interface resolution. A lower limit can improve performance at the cost of sharpness. Native uses the display resolution.
auga_graphics_tip_upscaling: Chooses how the 3D image is enlarged when rendered below the display resolution: smooth interpolation or more distinct pixels.
auga_graphics_tip_fps: Sets the maximum frames rendered per second. A limit can reduce hardware load; Unlimited allows the game to render as many frames as possible.
auga_graphics_tip_vsync: Synchronizes presentation with the display refresh rate to reduce screen tearing. It can affect smoothness and input response time.
auga_graphics_tip_preset: Sets a group of graphics quality values. Changes are saved with Apply. Editing a quality setting can switch the selection to Custom.
auga_graphics_tip_vegetation: Controls the density and rendering of small vegetation such as grass. Lower quality reduces the cost of rendering landscapes.
auga_graphics_tip_lod: Controls how far away objects switch to simpler models. Higher values preserve detail at greater distances, at a higher rendering cost.
auga_graphics_tip_clothquality: Controls cloth simulation quality, including capes. Lower values reduce the processing needed for cloth motion.
auga_graphics_tip_simulationdistance: Controls the area of the world loaded and simulated around the player. This is separate from level of detail. Large distances can greatly increase processing load and affect world simulation.
auga_graphics_tip_tesselation: Adds geometric detail to surfaces that support tessellation. Disabling it can reduce graphics load.
auga_graphics_tip_shadowquality: Controls shadow quality. Higher quality improves definition but requires more graphics performance.
auga_graphics_tip_lights: Controls lights produced by particle effects. Lower quality can improve performance during visually busy effects.
auga_graphics_tip_pointlights: Limits active point lights, such as torches. Higher limits allow more simultaneous lights but increase rendering cost.
auga_graphics_tip_pointlightshadows: Limits how many point lights can cast shadows. Shadows from many torches or other lights can be expensive to render.
auga_graphics_tip_ssao: Adds contact shading in creases and where objects meet to emphasize depth. Choose Off, Low or High to balance appearance and performance.
auga_graphics_tip_distantshadows: Displays shadows from distant objects. Disabling it reduces rendering cost but removes some distant shadows.
auga_graphics_tip_sunshafts: Displays visible sun rays around obstacles. This decorative effect can be disabled to reduce rendering work.
auga_graphics_tip_bloom: Adds a glow around bright areas. Disable it for less glow and sharper edges around light sources.
auga_graphics_tip_depthoffield: Blurs areas outside the focus plane. Disable it to keep the image sharp at all distances.
auga_graphics_tip_motionblur: Adds blur during movement to emphasize speed. Disable it to keep the image sharper while moving the camera.
auga_graphics_tip_chromaticaberration: Adds a slight separation of colors, especially near the screen edges. Disable it for cleaner outlines.
auga_graphics_tip_softparticles: Softens intersections between particles and surfaces, such as smoke meeting the ground. Disabling it can make these intersections more visible.
auga_graphics_tip_antialiasing: Reduces jagged object edges. It makes outlines smoother at an additional rendering cost.
